game_title: Dam Filler – Dragon Hoard Cave Race
game_concept: A adventure race set in Shadow Cave – Dragon Hoard Cave, a hoard-filled cave: the dwarf scout must handle rock golems while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Dam Filler: Raise the water level in a loop while level < max, without overflowing.
theme: Shadow Cave – Dragon Hoard Cave: a hoard-filled cave
core_gameplay_loop: In Dragon Hoard Cave, repeat each round: Raise the water level in a loop while level < max, without overflowing. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the dwarf scout ahead. Then check the level value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the crystal door by solving code steps involving level that move the dwarf scout forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.7).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the crystal door first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 5 (applied tier): Dam Filler
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Dam Filler' (Week 4 slot 8), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Dragon Hoard Cave'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how level changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rock golems in Dragon Hoard Cave.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.7).
